scenes.visual: Big navy hook text pops word by word; Norb peeks curious from below.
DNA strand with three toggle switches; sun icon overhead springs them all to teal ON, then cloud dims them to navy OFF — cycling.
scenes.voiceover: Your genes are more like a script than a verdict. The lines are written — but your environment decides which ones get performed.

scenes.visual: Split screen: teal orchid on the left wilts under a storm cloud then explosively blooms when sun appears; mustard dandelion on the right barely moves either way.
scenes.voiceover: Some genes make you extra-sensitive — to stress AND to kindness. Others are dandelion genes: tough in almost any soil.

scenes.visual: Two figures slide together; a warm teal pulse blooms between them — safe connection as the environmental trigger that flips the better genes on.
scenes.voiceover: You can't rewrite your genes. But you can change the stage. Safe bonds, sleep, and movement flip the better genes on.

scenes.visual: THE SCIENCE card; below it a crossover line chart draws in: steep teal SENSITIVE line vs flat mustard RESILIENT line across HARSH → NURTURING. Labels pop via spring.
scenes.cardText: Differential susceptibility: sensitive genes amplify BOTH bad and good environments.
scenes.voiceover: Differential susceptibility: the same gene variant that worsens outcomes in harsh environments also produces the best outcomes in nurturing ones.

scenes.visual: TRY THIS card; below it the DNA toggles spring to ON as the sun icon glows. Norb celebrates.
scenes.cardText:
Pick one environment to upgrade.
Better inputs — same genes, different you.
scenes.voiceover:
Pick one environment to upgrade this week.
Better inputs, same genes — different you.
